Messages.Author: Bradley Ward
Messages.Body:
When you use Hidden lurker to enter combat does the opposing vampire
have a chance to play Thrown Gate for the manuever to long range or
could the opposing vampire use the manuever from a .44 Magnum?

I believe that the manuevers from either case could not be used since
they are preludes to a strike. However we were all unclear about the
ruling on this scenario when it occured last night.

Thanks
Bradley

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Maneuvering with a strike means you are choosing your
strike as well. [6.4.2 p37] You cannot do so if you do not have
a strike.
